title: AI OKR Generator
prompt: OKRs [ROLE] [QUARTER]: objectives (inspiring), 3 key results each (measurable), confidence (0-1), stretch vs committed. Table.

title: AI Handoff Document
prompt: Project handoff: overview, status, done, in-progress, next (roadmap), issues, contacts, access, ongoing tasks.

title: AI Postmortem Template
prompt: Blameless postmortem: summary, timeline, impact, root cause (5 whys), factors, well/wrong, action items, lessons, follow-up date.

title: AI Change Management
prompt: Change mgmt [CHANGE]: what+why, who affected, comms plan, training, timeline, risks, metrics, rollback, recognition.

title: AI Hiring Rubric
prompt: Interview rubric [ROLE]: 5 competencies, behavioral Q+scoring(1-5), technical assessment, culture fit, red/green flags, decision matrix.

title: AI Vendor Evaluation
prompt: Vendor eval [CATEGORY]: capability(30%), pricing(20%), support(15%), security(15%), integration(10%), references(10%). Score 1-5.

title: AI Budget Request
prompt: Budget request [ITEM]: what, why (business case), cost breakdown, alternatives, ROI (timeframe+metrics), risk of not approving. Amount: $[AMOUNT].

title: AI Stakeholder Comms
prompt: Stakeholder comms [PROJECT]: map, each (frequency, format, content, channel, owner), messages by phase, escalation path.

title: AI Crisis Communication
prompt: Crisis comms [SCENARIO]: summary, key messages(3), Q&A (anticipated+answers), notification order, channels, timeline, spokesperson, monitoring.

title: AI 30-60-90 Plan
prompt: 30-60-90 plan [ROLE]: Days 1-30(Learn: orientation, training), 31-60(Contribute: own tasks), 61-90(Lead: responsibility, goals).

title: AI Department OKRs
prompt: Quarterly OKRs [DEPARTMENT]: objectives align to company goal. 3 key results each, owner, confidence. OKR tree.

title: AI Quarterly Planning
prompt: Quarterly plan [TEAM]: theme, top 3 goals (metrics), initiatives, capacity, risks, dependencies, metrics, weekly milestones.

title: AI Customer Success Plan
prompt: Customer success [CUSTOMER]: profile+goals, usage, adoption gaps, milestones(30/60/90), cadence, expansion, renewal risk, advocacy.

title: AI Partner Outreach
prompt: Partnership outreach [TARGET]: why (mutual benefit), who to contact, cold email, follow-up(3), meeting agenda, proposal, negotiation.

title: AI Renewal Strategy
prompt: Renewal [CUSTOMER]: health(1-10), usage, value delivered, risks, upsell, stakeholders, timeline, negotiation, retention backup.

title: AI Product Launch Plan
prompt: Product launch [PRODUCT]: goals, audience, messaging, channels, content, pricing, sales enablement, checklist, monitoring, rollback.

title: AI Customer Journey Map
prompt: Journey [PRODUCT]: Awareness/Consideration/Purchase/Onboarding/Usage/Support/Renewal. Each: goal, touchpoints, emotions, friction, metric.

title: AI Pricing Strategy
prompt: Pricing [PRODUCT]: value metrics, models, competitor pricing, sensitivity, tiers(3), free tier, discount, annual vs monthly.

title: AI Churn Analysis
prompt: Churn [PRODUCT]: rate+trend, segments, reasons, lifecycle timing, predictors, retention by segment, win-back, success metrics.

title: AI Expansion Plan
prompt: Market expansion [PRODUCT] [NEW MARKET]: opportunity, competition, entry strategy, localization, timeline, resources, risks, metrics, budget.

title: AI Meeting Facilitation
prompt: Facilitation [MEETING TYPE]: prep, opening (icebreaker+agenda), discussion (timeboxed), decision method, documentation, closing, follow-up.

title: AI Time Audit
prompt:
Analyze time log: by category(%), deep vs shallow, meeting vs solo, energy alignment, top 3 wasters, recommendations, ideal week.

[PASTE LOG]

title: AI SOP Writer
prompt: SOP [PROCESS]: purpose, scope, prerequisites, step-by-step, decision points, quality checks, troubleshooting, revision history.

title: AI Workflow Automation
prompt: Analyze workflow for automation: steps map, time per step, automation potential, tools, savings, ROI, implementation plan. Workflow: [DESCRIBE].

title: AI Knowledge Base
prompt: KB [TEAM]: categories(5-7), sub-categories, templates, tagging, search, access control, maintenance, contribution guidelines.

title: AI Process Improvement
prompt: Improve process (lean): value stream map, waste(8 types), bottlenecks, root causes, future state, actions (impact/effort), metrics, timeline.

title: AI Document Template
prompt: Template [DOCUMENT TYPE]: structure, each section (purpose, content, example), placeholders, formatting, required vs optional, checklist.

title: AI Checklist Creator
prompt: Checklist [PROCESS]: pre-task checks, steps (ordered), quality checks, post-task verification, common mistakes, escalation triggers.

title: AI Email Template Pack
prompt: Email templates [ROLE]: introduction, follow-up, request, update, apology, celebration, resignation, welcome. Each: subject+body+[PLACEHOLDERS].

title: AI Agile Retrospective
prompt: Retrospective [SPRINT]: what went well(3-5), improvements(3-5), action items(SMART+owner), health(1-5: trust/comm/velocity/quality), commitments.

title: AI Task Prioritization
prompt:
Prioritize tasks: impact/effort matrix, Eisenhower, dependencies, energy, recommended order, delegate, drop, schedule. Tasks:

[PASTE]

title: AI Status Report Template
prompt: Status report [PROJECT]: health(green/yellow/red), progress(bullets), metrics(vs target), risks, next week, decisions, asks. 1-page.

title: AI Meeting Design
prompt: Meeting formats [TEAM]: standup(10m), weekly(30m), sprint planning(2h), retro(1h), 1:1(30m), all-hands(30m). Each: purpose, agenda, output, async alt.

title: AI Knowledge Transfer
prompt: Knowledge transfer [PERSON LEAVING]: what they know, relationships, projects, context, documentation, shadowing, handoff sessions, support, checklist.

title: AI Workspace Setup
prompt: Workspace [ROLE]: physical (desk, monitor, chair, lighting), digital (tools, shortcuts), file org, comms, focus, ergonomics, stack, routine.

title: AI Data Cleaning
prompt: Data cleaning [DATASET]: quality (completeness/accuracy), missing strategy, outliers, standardization, deduplication, validation, script (Python/SQL).

title: AI Dashboard Design
prompt: Dashboard [AUDIENCE]: metrics(top 5), layout(F-pattern), chart types, filters, drill-downs, colors(accessible), refresh, mobile. Tool: [DESCRIBE].

title: AI A/B Test Design
prompt: A/B test [HYPOTHESIS]: hypothesis, primary+secondary metrics, sample size, duration, traffic split, guardrails, statistical method, decision, rollout.

title: AI SQL Optimization
prompt:
Optimize SQL: execution analysis, indexes, joins, subquery to CTE, partitioning, materialized views, optimized query, improvement.

[PASTE SQL]

title: AI Data Governance
prompt: Governance [ORG]: classification (public/internal/confidential), roles (owner/steward/custodian), quality, access, retention, privacy (GDPR), audit, response.

title: AI ML Model Spec
prompt: Model spec [TASK]: problem type, features, target, candidates(3), metrics, splits, hyperparameters, deployment, monitoring. Task: [DESCRIBE].

title: AI Data Pipeline Architecture
prompt: Pipeline: sources, ingestion(batch/streaming), staging, transforms, warehouse, quality, orchestration(Airflow), monitoring, cost, scalability. ASCII diagram.

title: AI Metrics Framework
prompt: Metrics [PRODUCT]: North Star(1), input(3-5 leading), output(3-5 lagging), guardrails(3). Each: definition, formula, source, frequency, target, owner. Dashboard.

title: AI Data Migration
prompt: Migration [OLD] to [NEW]: profiling, schema mapping, transformations, strategy(big bang/phased/parallel), quality checks, rollback, cutover, validation.

title: AI Exploratory Data Analysis
prompt: EDA [DATASET]: overview(shape/types/missing), univariate(distributions), bivariate(correlations), outliers, feature engineering, hypotheses, 5 charts, next steps. Python snippets.

title: AI Prompt Pattern Library
prompt: Reusable prompt pattern [TASK]: name, when to use, template(with [PLACEHOLDERS]), filled example, variations, failure modes, tips, alternatives.

title: AI Agent Design Doc
prompt: Agent [USE CASE]: goal, tools, decision logic(flowchart), memory, error handling, human-in-loop, evaluation, cost/run, failure modes. Framework: [LANGGRAPH/CREWAI].

title: AI RAG System Design
prompt: RAG [USE CASE]: sources, chunking(size+overlap), embedding, vector store, retrieval(semantic+keyword), reranking, context window, prompt, eval, cost/query.

title: AI Fine-Tuning Plan
prompt: Fine-tuning [MODEL] [TASK]: base model, data(size/format/quality), preparation, method(LoRA/full), hyperparams, evaluation, inference opt, cost, rollback.

title: AI Evaluation Framework
prompt: Eval [SYSTEM]: dimensions(accuracy/safety/helpfulness/latency/cost), test data, metrics(automated+human), rubric, baseline, regression, monitoring, reporting.

title: AI Safety Checklist
prompt: Safety [SYSTEM]: input validation(injection/jailbreak), output filtering(toxicity/PII/hallucination), bias, privacy, security, transparency, oversight, response.

title: AI MCP Server Design
prompt: MCP server [CAPABILITY]: capability, tools(schemas), resources(URIs), prompts(templates), auth, error handling, testing, deployment, documentation.

title: AI LLM Router Strategy
prompt: LLM routing [APP]: task categories, model per category(+fallback), routing logic, cost optimization(cheap first), quality monitoring, latency, fallback chain, A/B.

title: AI Workflow Orchestrator
prompt: Orchestration: task decomposition, agent assignment, data flow, error handling+retry, parallelization, checkpoints+human review, timeout+budget, monitoring, output.

title: AI Conversation Design
prompt: Conversation [CHATBOT]: intents(list), each(triggers 5+/slots/response/follow-up), fallback, repair, escalation, personalization, tone guide, metrics.
